reviews.title: 7cubic ft freezer
reviews.review_text: Bought this May 5 had it by the next week let it sit for 24 hours and then plugged it in and it's been freezing ever since I started loading it up immediately when I knew it was freezing I put a bowl of water in it and it just started freezing I knew it was good. Anyways, it's been a great extra freezer for my deer meat, and a few veggies and things. I would definitely recommend this freezer.

reviews.title: Be there to except the Delivery.
reviews.review_text: BE there when it's delivered ! The delivery was early by two days, But Walmart didn't call or bring it to our Attention, Delivery, dropped it off at our garage, and Drove off!, no alert , no call, no customer acceptance/examination (puncture in lower right side of box) nothing. Our neighbor called to let us no there was a delivery left in front of garage (which we can not see from our front door) I could have seen the hole and NOT excepted/Refused delivery. Now that I see, the Freezer Does, have a Puncture through side. In lieu of scheduling another Pick-up/ delivery, I would Accept a $40.00 Walmart Gift Card, and leave it at that, and you would end up with a Happy customer! Now, I'd be leery of Deliveries, next time. Thank you, FSR,VA

reviews.title: Needs a door handle
reviews.review_text: Nice little unit. No handle on side of door. If top is used for handle, door will be twisted in no time. I put a handle on side of door at midpoint. 2 screws

reviews.title: functional with useful features and a dent
reviews.review_text: it came with a dent on the top back left. useful features to change the side where the door opened. inexpensive but still would expect it to come without a dent.

reviews.title: Arrived damaged
reviews.review_text: The freezer worked well right away. I have not tried the refrigerator feature. It was packaged well without any damage to the box or packing materials. The door has a pretty significant dent. A number of the other reviews noted damage to their units, so clearly this is an issue that the manufacturer needs to address.

reviews.title: If you dont mind challenges. Buy it.
reviews.review_text: The unit arrived in a box. box seemed fine. The top right door and hinge were pretty damaged. I needed the hinge to be on the left side, and the unit came with additional left hinge. After switching hinges I realized the door wouldn't close. I used rope to hold door shut to test refrigerator setting. It took a couple tries but I got the unit cooling at 36 degrees fahrenheit. Also the door seals once it is cooling. For me it was a win. I dont care if the door looks damaged. The unit keeps my food cold. The price is right. Dont purchase if you aren't willing to work for a win.

reviews.title: Delivery Problems
reviews.review_text: I think the product is good and it was definitely checked before shipping. Maybe it was due to shipping. The refrigerator I received had a dent on the corner.

reviews.title: saved money!
reviews.review_text: The same item was for sale at Lowe's but with. $100 delivery charge added. Free shipping meant FedEx left it in my front yard. If I had wanted it unpackaged and installed in my house by somebody else, a delivery charge might have been reasonable. But I own a hand cart and did all that myself. It's not that heavy; I am a 75 year old 5'3" female, and having FedEx leave it in front of the house for free was not a problem for me.

Purchased online on 12/26, delivered on 12/30. The carton did not have any outward damage. When I removed the shipping carton every side of the freezer had multiple dents, and one puncture right through the side. Thee unit was definitely damaged before it was shipped.

reviews.title: Arrived damaged, but spacious inside.
reviews.review_text: Arrived in a box that looked like the bottom had fallen completely out of it and had then been taped back together with packaging tape. Once opened, I discovered there was damage to the bottom/back of the freezer. Fortunately it seems to be exterior only damage. Despite arriving in less than new condition, the freezer appears to be working well. It has a spacious interior with stylish glass shelving. I'm liking it so far.

reviews.title: Poor Delivery Service
reviews.review_text: I received an email that I would received the merchandise( Upright freezer) I ordered on Dec. 8th. Well, on Dec. 1st; as I was preparing my day take handle business, I came downstairs( finding my daughter already down there)to check the weather and when I opened the door there was a huge box sitting in front of the door of my apartment. I was startled but also glad to get my freezer. Had to change my whole day because of the early delivery. The maintenance dept at my apt complex saw the box in front of my door came over and offered to bring the box inside my apt. Wow, was I grateful and appreciative for their help. I was able to open the box, take the freezer out to find a damaged dent on the left side of the freezer( if your standing in front of the freezer). I did take pictures of the damaged area. I was able to get the freezer in my kitchen, wipe it down and clean it and place everything perspectively according to the directions given. As I was reading the direction, I noticed that there were pieces (screws) missing that was suppose to be with the merchandise. If I wanted to switch sides of the door to open to the other direction I am not able to do so because of the missing pieces. I truly hope I will never have to go through an experience like this again because it would be hard for me to recommend ordering huge items from Walmart.com to anyone wondering if they would have the same or similar experience. Thats not fair to the customer to pay large amounts of money to receive damaged merchandise at delivery. I am an honest person and I practice treating people like I desire to be treated. Although this experience left a bad taste in my mouth, I am currently using the freezer and it seems to be working fine so far. I really like this freezer, it was just what I was looking for and at a reasonable price. Walmart.com, I have been ordering merchandise for several years now and would like to continue doing business with your company, but I would recommend better delivery service ethics for better customer service, because you may not get a more positive or understanding person on an experience like this the next time; there are some pretty mean and nasty people in this world and they can be pretty nasty about an experience like mine. I hope that your delivery service would consider better customer service for the sake of the company. Thank you for the opportunity to express my experience and hope you have a real nice day

reviews.title: Ours arrived in good shape!
reviews.review_text: We were worried reading the reviews about major dents and dings since this was a garage-rated freezer we decided the price was right we would risk it and keep it baring it being extremely dented. We received our order in 2 days via fedex from KC to NE and we opened a pristine freezer. I am 6 months pregnant and was able to get it into the garage and hooked up alone. Likely the short distance of shipping to us in the midwest accounted for it being in better shape because the packaging was probably not adequate for a longer trip.

reviews.title: upright versus chest style freezers.
reviews.review_text: So Much easier loading and unloading an upright freezer with movable shelves. With a chest type if you want one particular item it's going to be buried on bottom everytime.

reviews.title: Worth the Price BUT
reviews.review_text: The item arrived pretty dinged up. It worked so I kept it. From looking at the comments, this is a common thread. Walmart needs to invest in packing it better because the DeliveryDrivers dont care.

Had a issue with getting it to work. I had to take the thermostat cover off the plug came loose during shipping to get it to run. Other than that it's up and running. I do like the fact it has a refrigerator and freezer mode.

This would have been a 5 star review, but there were issues getting it. The freezer itself is perfect for my needs. Small, yet plenty of space for items. Cooled down to 0 degrees within an hour or so after plugging it in. However, my original order was lost somehow (how do you lose a large item like a freezer?). Walmart customer service was pretty good at getting a replacement sent but it took much longer to get than it should have.

reviews.title: Dents %26 Scratches
reviews.review_text: The freezer seems to be working so far, but my concern is that the life of the refrigerator won't be long because of the dents and scratches when it arrived. Plus, It is hard to open the door. The suction is powerful, but I guess that will keep the cold inside 😀. The size is great for us. It is extremely quiet. I don't have it on high, yet everything is rock solid frozen. The 2 star rating is the fear factor of the unknown problems due to the dents on the freezer.
It's was just the size we needed without spending a lot more money.

reviews.title: Exactly as described
reviews.review_text: Exactly as described. Meets all my requirements
I was worried about it being damaged during shipping but despite the box being broken it doesn’t have any damage and is cooling just fine.

First the measurements are in correct. The height is stated at 53.7 and in actuality it is 50. Depth was listed at 24.2 and was 22.5. The width was 24.4 and was 21.75. Which is noted further down but not in the picture. Which to me is false advertising. But the issue was we read the review they received it damaged by FedEx. However, the box came in full tact with a few spots but did not correlate with the damage on the unit! Which leads me to believe prior to being shipped it is already damaged. Not to mention we had challenges with damage inside the unit nothing that would be an issue but still damage on the bottom of the unit.

reviews.title: DENT
reviews.review_text: ARRIVED WITH DENT ON TOP . BOX NOT DAMAGED AT ALL SO HAD TO BE PACKED WITH THE DENT .

reviews.title: Came in looking like it was dropped off the truck.
reviews.review_text: As stated it looks like it was dropped. Now I have to find a way to get it 35 miles to the closest store. I own a small car. Pictures tell it all
just received this and it has a dent top right hand corner.
The freezer arrived with a dent on the lower right side and a crease on the back plate
well it came with a dent in the top.... but we'll see how it works....

reviews.title: Things are not always as the seem
reviews.review_text: I was a little concerned when my shipment arrived, because the box was obviously retaped with silver duct tape, but upon opening the box the freezer was intact and packing inside was still in place, so waited the appropriate amount of time before proceeding to plug it in, and it works just fine, used a temperature gauge to make sure it was at 0% F before placing any food inside. So it seems it was returned because someone decided it was either to big or to small for their needs who knows in any case it works. Just wasn't expecting to receive a returned item was under the assumption it was new.

reviews.title: It work for three weeks
reviews.review_text: I had gotten it and it was fine at first I like that it was small because I’m in a apartment but just the other day I saw water on the floor and I was like what’s this. So then I waited a day and it’s still not on so this freezer isn’t good or at least for me it wasn’t.

reviews.title: so far so good
reviews.review_text: Freezer arrived with a couple of dings and dents, nothing too major, but somewhat disappointing for a new freezer. It definitely gets cold, I will be putting a remote thermostat in it to confirm temperature and so I get an alert if the freezer quits on me, so I dont loose everything inside. The freezer is unusually loud, you can hear the refrigerant running through it, rather loudly when its running. much louder then any other refrigerator or freezer that I have owned. hope thats not a bad sign....
The price range and size. Also being delivered to my house.
We love the size of the freezer but it arrived damaged.

reviews.title: Its ok
reviews.review_text: Had a large dent in the side worth the price, not enough to hassle with a return

reviews.title: misinformation
reviews.review_text: On line it stated this was a frost free; that is not the case
Received the freezer, plugged it in and worked for 24 hours then stopped freezing
Overall a good freezer, but like many others here, my freezer arrived dented (see pics). Be prepared.
